subject: Charged twice for our annual renewal - $960 out of nowhere
body: We were charged $960 on the 3rd and then another $960 on the 4th. Our finance team has flagged both. We only have one subscription. I need the second charge refunded to the card today, and I'd like written confirmation before I have to explain this to our CFO.

customer.notes: Renewed annually in advance. Billing contact is the CFO's assistant.
